title: verify handles rsaEncryption OID in signatureAlgorithm by falling back to digestAlgorithm field
description: verify.rs verify_sig() has a branch for *sig_alg_oid == RSA_ENCRYPTION (1.2.840.113549.1.1.1) that falls back to reading the digest algorithm from the SignerInfo.digestAlgorithm field. A future contributor might remove this branch as 'unnecessary' since the primary branches already cover sha256WithRSAEncryption etc. That would be wrong: RFC 5652 §5.4 and RFC 5751 §2.1 explicitly permit implementations to use the generic rsaEncryption OID in signatureAlgorithm rather than the hash-specific combined OID. Older implementations (pre-2000 S/MIME v2 and some OpenSSL configurations) produce this form. Removing the fallback would cause silent verification failures on real-world messages without any clear error.
